board-minutes-of-meeting.0: Board minutes of meeting are not ordinary meeting notes. Indian company law treats properly kept minutes as evidence of what the board decided, and they get checked in audits, due diligence and disputes. One missing resolution or unsigned page can cause real headaches years later.
board-minutes-of-meeting.9: Keep discussion summaries short and resolution text exact. Why? Banks, auditors and registrars will ask for the resolution.
board-minutes-of-meeting.19: Need minutes for general meetings outside the board? See our [minutes of meeting format](https://lynkk.ai/blog/minutes-of-meeting-format) and how [meeting notes and minutes](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-notes-vs-minutes) differ.
board-minutes-of-meeting.23: Signed minutes should not be altered. Any correction should be approved at a later board meeting and recorded in that meeting's minutes. Never edit a signed page or use loose sheets. Fixes belong in the next meeting's minutes, which keeps the record trustworthy as evidence.
